description.narrative: The project aims to achieve two main objectives 1. Improving the institutional and organizational governance of COSCE, alongside strengthening the capacities of its member organizations, will ensure that civil society is better equipped to play a proactive, informed, and rights-based role in democratic processes. This will enhance their ability to advocate for and protect fundamental human rights—such as freedom of expression, political participation, equality, and access to justice—while promoting inclusive governance and accountability across Senegal 2. Strengthening and structuring interactions between civil society actors and Members of Parliament (MPs) will help create inclusive and constructive platforms for dialogue and collaboration. These spaces will focus on public policy oversight and citizen engagement, to protect fundamental freedoms and budgetary issues and the public debt situation.. For each expected outcome, a set of 3 activities will be conducted. -Objective 1: Strengthening the institutional and organizational capacity of COSCE three training-focused activities will be carried out to build individual competencies and collectively empower the institution at both organizational and institutional levels. -Objective 2: Promoting dialogue between civil society actors and Members of Parliament (MPs): Three activities will be conducted to establish mechanisms for interaction and define key topics for discussion. These initiatives will foster meaningful exchanges and collaboration around public policy issues. Achieving these specific objectives will in the long term strengthen and frame the conditions for contributing to the consolidation of democratic and parliamentary governance, and human rights, in Senegal.
